note: Taj Green Cove is featured. Details were researched online on 4 November 2026 and each venue lists its sources; where sources disagree, its note says so. Photos are only shown where a freely licensed photo of the actual venue exists (Wikimedia Commons, credited); other venues show a monogram and, where available, a link to their official gallery. Confirm names, addresses, star ratings and capacities with each venue before quoting them to clients.

venues.name: Taj Green Cove Resort & Spa, Kovalam
venues.address: G.V. Raja Vattapara Road, Kovalam, Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala 695527
venues.description: A clifftop resort above the Arabian Sea at Kovalam. Its seaside lawns hold the largest weddings in the area, and two pillarless halls suit receptions and pre-wedding functions.

spaces.name: Agora Hall
spaces.note: Pillarless; capacity from a third-party listing

spaces.name: Tango
spaces.note: Pillarless, natural light; capacity from a third-party listing

spaces.name: Cabana Lawns
spaces.note: Sea and lagoon views; family get-togethers

features: Kovalam's largest open-air wedding lawn, facing the Arabian Sea
venues.verification: Checked online on 4 November 2026. The six spaces, the Agora Lawns size and capacity (3,000), the Seaside Lawn (800) and the Agora Hall size are from Taj's events page. Agora Hall and Tango capacities, the room count and the phone number come from third-party listings (WeddingWire, WedMeGood, MIT). Photo: the resort's infinity pool (2005), Wikimedia Commons.

venues.name: Hyatt Regency Trivandrum
venues.address: C V Raman Pillai Road, DPI, Thycaud, Thiruvananthapuram 695014
venues.description: A city-centre five-star hotel at Thycaud with one of Thiruvananthapuram's largest pillarless halls, The Great Hall, plus a ballroom that divides into four.
features: About 20,000 sq ft of event space
venues.verification: Capacities from Hyatt's meetings page; total event space from Cvent. Some booking sites list the area as Vazhuthacaud. Hyatt's site blocks automated checks, so its links couldn't be re-opened on 4 November 2026.
